authority: City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council

catalog_evidence: Official data.gov.uk record identifies City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council as publisher and states the dataset covers freehold/leasehold land and/or buildings owned or leased by Bradford Council; it cautions that some polygon boundaries may not be definitive.
layer_evidence: Official Bradford GIS MapServer identifies layer 0 as Bradford Council Assets, geometry type esriGeometryPolygon, and exposes ARN, NAME, BUDGETARYSERVICE, TENURE, STATUS and ASSETUSE attributes.
acceptance_decision: No records accepted because the <=50 query payload was not retrievable in the available web transport and dataset-level metadata does not establish that every polygon is an actual building footprint rather than a land/holding boundary.
first_missing_criterion: retrievable official feature rows (<=50) plus per-feature proof that each polygon is a building footprint rather than a land/holding boundary, with explicit ASSETUSE/type evidence
next_changed_method: Do not retry the Bradford One Public Estate MapServer query or Hub download. Next turn use a previously unused official source whose published polygons are explicitly building footprints and whose static feature payload is directly retrievable in the available transport.
